mode: Selected existing generated photo/stage artwork; generated one transparent pitcher with built-in image_gen. Typography, grounds and layouts composed separately.
comparisonPolicy: Poster: only shade opacity changes from 0 to 1, with transparent-to-black gradient fixed. Product: only the backdrop fill changes from #292b2b to #e7e3d8; the identical unretouched RGBA cutout, geometry and fitting rule are reused. Dialog: only screen-clipped underlay opacity changes from 0 to 0.48, below an identical opaque foreground. All copy, type, other geometry, source image/crops, paper/device and lighting stay fixed.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared figure-ground intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: All six final browser PNGs visually inspected, including corrected screen-top dimmer coverage and final confirmation wording. Text fits the paper/phone surface and no horizontal overflow occurs. Pixel masks isolate declared ground-change regions; two opaque dialog-interior regions are explicitly excluded from permissible changes and remain identical. DOM comparisons preserve copy, typography, positions, image data/crops and unrelated attributes. Product invariants concern its identical RGBA source and placement, not every final composited pixel.
verification.textContrastBound: For the four light text lines inside the stable 0.76 black-shade region, a white source pixel gives a conservative maximum background. The declared foreground/background bound exceeds 4.5:1. This checks those specified lines, not overall artifact accessibility.

alpha_validation.note: The generated cutout has near-opaque interior alpha as well as transparent edges and shadow; changing the ground can slightly affect composited tones. The source RGBA file is identical and unretouched in both variants.

limitations: No audience study, measured recognition/reading/task benefit, physical print trial, assistive-technology audit, implemented modal behavior, whole-artifact accessibility conformance or full production-route result. Product name, capacity and price are fictional example copy, not verified specifications.
